mapper.update: UPDATE wa_group wa_group INNER JOIN group_link handle ON handle.tenant_id = wa_group.tenant_id AND handle.group_id = wa_group.id SET wa_group.display_name = CASE WHEN #{row.displayNameObserved} THEN #{row.displayName} ELSE wa_group.display_name END, wa_group.remark = CASE WHEN #{row.remarkObserved} THEN #{row.remark} ELSE wa_group.remark END, wa_group.avatar_url = CASE WHEN #{row.avatarObserved} THEN #{row.avatarUrl} ELSE wa_group.avatar_url END, wa_group.deleted_at = NULL, wa_group.updated_at = GREATEST(wa_group.updated_at, #{row.updatedAt}) WHERE wa_group.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND handle.id = #{row.groupLinkId}

UPDATE wa_group_invite invite INNER JOIN group_link handle ON handle.tenant_id = invite.tenant_id AND handle.group_invite_id = invite.id SET invite.display_name = CASE WHEN #{row.displayNameObserved} THEN #{row.displayName} ELSE invite.display_name END, invite.remark = CASE WHEN #{row.remarkObserved} THEN #{row.remark} ELSE invite.remark END, invite.avatar_url = CASE WHEN #{row.avatarObserved} THEN #{row.avatarUrl} ELSE invite.avatar_url END, invite.deleted_at = NULL, invite.updated_at = GREATEST(invite.updated_at, #{row.updatedAt}) WHERE invite.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND invite.group_id IS NULL AND handle.group_id IS NULL AND handle.id = #{row.groupLinkId}

UPDATE wa_group_invite invite INNER JOIN group_link handle ON handle.tenant_id = invite.tenant_id AND handle.group_invite_id = invite.id SET invite.label_id = #{labelId}, invite.deleted_at = NULL, invite.updated_at = GREATEST(invite.updated_at, #{updatedAt}) WHERE invite.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND handle.id IN
#{groupLinkId}

#{groupLinkId}
